name: stri_enc_isutf16le
title: Check If a Data Stream Is Possibly in UTF-16LE

origin.description: Report whether each byte string can be UTF-16LE.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, a raw vector, or a list of raw vectors.

origin.details: The byte length must be even. A NUL code unit, an unpaired surrogate, or a BOM of the other endianness is FALSE. An empty byte string is TRUE.
origin.value: A logical vector. One raw vector is one logical value.

translation.description: Report whether each byte string can be UTF-16LE.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, bytes, a list of strings, or a list of byte vectors. None is one missing value for a raw checker and an empty character vector for text.

translation.details: The byte length must be even. A NUL code unit, an unpaired surrogate, or a BOM of the other endianness is false. An empty byte string is true.
translation.value: True, False, or NA. A list returns a list.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_enc_isutf16le
x = stri_enc_isutf16le(bytes([97, 0, 98, 0]))
print(f"stri_enc_isutf16le(bytes([97, 0, 98, 0])) returns {'TRUE' if x else 'FALSE'}.")
